title: A coherent module on a Noetherian scheme is filtered with quotients pushforwards of ideal sheaves of integral closed subschemes
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], i.e. locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $\mathcal F$ be a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Then there are an integer $m\ge0$ and a chain $0=\mathcal F_0\subseteq\mathcal F_1\subseteq\dots\subseteq\mathcal F_m=\mathcal F$ of coherent sub-$\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] such that for every $j=1,\dots,m$ there are a closed immersion $i_j:Z_j\to X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion] with $Z_j$ an integral scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme] and a nonzero coherent sheaf of ideals $\mathcal I_j\subseteq\mathcal O_{Z_j}$ with an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_X$-modules $\mathcal F_j/\mathcal F_{j-1}\cong(i_j)_*\mathcal I_j$, where $\mathcal F_j/\mathcal F_{j-1}$ is the cokernel of the inclusion $\mathcal F_{j-1}\to\mathcal F_j$ and $(i_j)_*$ is the pushforward of modules [def-pc-module-pullback].

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01YF (label lemma-coherent-filter, coherent.tex line 3051); its proof uses Lemmas 01YD (lemma-prepare-filter-support), 01Y9 (lemma-power-ideal-kills-sheaf), 01YE (lemma-prepare-filter-irreducible) and Noetherian induction on the support
